comments: Agent1 is the initiator and ego is the responder (input facts). Assumptions: opposing straight approaches at a four-way intersection; a prior collision immediately before the modeled episode has deflected agent1 left. Agent1 starts on its original incoming trafficway in its original direction of travel and immediately follows a conflicting left-turn connector as a kinematic post-impact displacement surrogate. The prior impact and an additional collision partner are not modeled. Ego follows its straight trajectory and commands a stop when agent1 enters a 16–20 m safety radius. Approach speeds are 7–9 m/s, initial partner separation 22–48 m. Opportunity for conflict is intended; collision is not required.
